description: Searched in Hungarian for a standalone MNB cash report ('Készpénzjelentés' / 'készpénz jelentés') analogous to the Payment Systems Report.

result.result_summary: No standalone recurring MNB cash report surfaced. Cash statistics appear distributed across the bankjegy-és-érme web pages, the monthly MNB balance-sheet release (currency in circulation), the Annual Report cash chapter, and occasional MNB-szemle studies.

why_it_matters: Collection design must assemble the HU cash picture from several releases rather than tracking one report; assuming a single cash report would create a coverage hole.

description: The English legacy path www.mnb.hu/en/statistics/statistical-data-and-information/statistical-time-series/xiv-payment-systems/payment-data (surfaced by search) was fetched.

result.result_summary: Returned HTTP 404. Content appears to have migrated to the statisztika.mnb.hu portal (statistical-topics/payment-systems). Recorded as unverified/likely-moved, not dead.

why_it_matters: Old mnb.hu/en statistics deep links are stale across search indexes; the collector should canonicalise to statisztika.mnb.hu and treat legacy mnb.hu/en/statistics paths as redirects to resolve.

description: Attempted to identify stable direct xlsx/csv download URLs for the quarterly payment time series from the release pages.

result.result_summary: Release pages describe downloadable time series and press releases but the rendered markdown did not expose stable file URLs; assets are likely served via dynamic /sw/static/file/ style paths or JS-rendered lists.

why_it_matters: The collector will need a rendering-capable fetch (or link-pattern discovery on /sw/static/file/) rather than static link scraping to obtain the workbooks.

description: Looked for an MNB open-data API or bulk endpoint for payment/cash statistics.

result.result_summary: No MNB statistics API was identified in this pass; MNB publishes via web pages, Excel time series and PDFs. (MNB does expose an exchange-rate web service, which is out of scope for this cell.)

why_it_matters: Machine-readable acquisition for HU payment data likely has to go through the ECB Data Portal SDMX API, with MNB files as the authoritative but manual-format source.

description: No documented bulk export, open-data dump or public API was found for the MNB Intézménykereső / Piaci szereplők keresése register during this scouting pass; the surfaces found are interactive search UIs.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced only the search interfaces (intezmenykereso.mnb.hu, mnb.hu piaci szereplők keresése) and no data.gov-style export endpoint.

why_it_matters: Automated actor-map maintenance may require HTML/XHR scraping of the MNB UI, or falling back to the EBA central register bulk download, which is authoritative only for PSD2-scope entities (not for all credit institutions).

description: No MNB register specifically listing ATM operators, POS acquirers or terminal deployers as a distinct licensed category was found. Acquiring appears only as an activity inside payment-institution/credit-institution licences.

result.result_summary: Searches on payment-institution licensing taxonomy and registers returned licence-category pages but nothing enumerating ATM/POS network operators.

why_it_matters: Identifying the HU POS/ATM operator landscape (directly relevant to a terminal-hardware market view) will need derivation from licence-activity fields plus the Payment Systems Report aggregates, not a single register.

description: A 2026 edition of the Fizetési rendszer jelentés was not located; only editions through 2025 were surfaced.

result.result_summary: Search results list 2023/2024/2025 editions and a publication calendar page; the 2026 edition may exist but was not confirmed in this pass.

why_it_matters: Latest-vintage figures may be missing; the publication calendar should be consulted to schedule the check rather than assuming absence.

description: All URLs in this slice come from search results or from two pages fetched successfully (MNB EN market participants, statisztika.mnb.hu supervisory statistics). The remaining URLs were not individually fetched and are therefore unverified for liveness.

result.result_summary: No fetch failures were observed; no URL is asserted here as verified reachable.

why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve every URL; MNB path structures are long and have been reorganised historically (an /archivum/ tree exists), so 404-and-move is plausible for older paths.

description: Two targeted Hungarian-language searches aimed at Napi.hu payments/cash coverage ('napi.hu készpénzfelvétel MNB pénzforgalmi jelentés cikk' and a quoted-domain query) returned no napi.hu article URLs at all — only MNB primary pages and unrelated comparison sites.

result.result_summary: Napi.hu recorded as a candidate on brief-inference only, with confidence 0.5; its payments coverage density is unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: If Napi.hu's payments output is thin or poorly indexed, crawler effort should go to Portfolio.hu/bonline.hu instead; conversely the absence may be a search-index artefact and warrants an on-site search check.

description: A Hungarian-language query for vg.hu (Világgazdaság) coverage of card transaction and POS terminal data returned no vg.hu articles; the same media group's bonline.hu surfaced instead with the substantive acquiring analysis.

result.result_summary: vg.hu retained at medium priority/0.6 confidence; bonline.hu promoted to critical in its place.

why_it_matters: Indicates the VG group's payments reporting may now be published primarily under bonline.hu — collection design should target that domain first and treat vg.hu as a possible duplicate feed.

description: No page in this slice was retrieved with a fetch tool; all evidence is from Hungarian- and English-language search result snippets and titles. Liveness, paywall state, robots.txt and consent-wall behaviour are therefore unknown for every candidate.

result.result_summary: All access_status and legal_status values are hypotheses, not observations.

why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must establish liveness and paywall/robots status before any crawler is built; nothing here should be treated as verified reachable.

description: 'POS terminál' as a search term is dominated in Hungarian by vendor and affiliate marketing pages (SumUp, Global Payments, novopayment.hu, cmo.hu, jogilexikon.hu, bankkartyaterminalok.hu) rather than journalism or statistics.

result.result_summary: Noisy term; the productive local variants were 'kártyaelfogadóhely', 'fizetéselfogadás' and 'elfogadóhelyek száma'.

why_it_matters: Query templates for this cell must avoid bare 'POS terminál' or pair it with statistical qualifiers, otherwise the crawler drowns in vendor SEO content.

description: No Hungarian trade-media outlet in this cell was found to publish a downloadable dataset, API or machine-readable series on payments; all quantified output is embedded in prose articles.

result.result_summary: Collection for this cell must be text-extraction based, not data-feed based.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for the pipeline: NLP/figure-extraction from HU-language article text plus reconciliation against MNB tables, rather than structured ingestion.

description: No Hungary-specific EY payments or cash-usage study was surfaced despite HU-language searching ('EY Magyarország pénzügyi szolgáltatások kutatás', 'fogyasztói bizalom bank').

result.result_summary: Searches returned academic dissertations and McKinsey material instead of EY Hungary outputs; EY HU is retained as a low-priority actor placeholder only.

why_it_matters: One of the four Big-4 firms may be effectively absent from the HU payments research landscape, or its outputs are only distributed via press releases/LinkedIn rather than an indexed insights page.

description: eNET (enet.hu) appears repeatedly as the origin of widely-cited online-shopping/payment-trust surveys, but all retrieved evidence came via third-party coverage (HWSW, Origo) rather than a current eNET publication page.

result.result_summary: No live eNET research listing was observed in this pass; its recent research output could not be dated. Access status recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: If eNET has wound down its public research output, the historic cash-on-delivery series must be back-filled from media archives instead of the originator.

description: No evidence found that Budapest LAB (BGE's entrepreneurship research centre) produces payment-habits or cash-usage research specifically; its HU-language footprint in these searches was financial literacy and SME finance.

result.result_summary: HU query combining Budapest LAB with fizetési szokások returned only financial-literacy education studies.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-scoping the academic actor map; BGE should be tracked for financial-literacy context, not payment statistics.

description: GKID's full Online Kiskereskedelmi Index / Digitális Kereskedelmi Körkép reports are commercial products; only press releases and partner reposts are free.

result.result_summary: Public layer gives headline payment-mix percentages but not the underlying breakdowns.

why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if granular e-commerce payment-mix time series are required; otherwise collection must rely on press-release-level figures.

description: Deloitte Hungary content is split across the legacy www2.deloitte.com/hu and the current www.deloitte.com/hu; several relevant articles were found only on the legacy host.

result.result_summary: Two parallel URL spaces observed for the same publisher; liveness of legacy URLs not asserted here.

why_it_matters: A crawler pinned to one host will silently miss or lose material; both hosts must be in the collection config, with redirect-following enabled.

description: No public register or dataset was found listing ATM locations/counts per operator per settlement, which would be the natural compliance artefact of the 2025. évi XVIII. törvény ATM mandate.

result.result_summary: Searches in HU on ATM telepítési kötelezettség returned the law, government press and media summaries, but no MNB or ministry-published compliance register of installed ATMs by settlement.

why_it_matters: Without such a register, ATM-mandate compliance tracking must be reconstructed from MNB aggregate statistics, bank disclosures and Euronet/operator press releases.

description: No Hungary-specific trade association or industry body for cash-in-transit / cash processing was identified in this pass.

result.result_summary: HU searches surfaced individual firms and a security-industry directory (SecuriFocus) but no CIT-sector association publishing market volumes; the general security-industry chamber was not confirmed as a cash-cycle publisher.

why_it_matters: A sector association would normally be the cheapest source of market-size and volume aggregates; its absence pushes reliance on company filings (e-beszámoló) and procurement data.

description: No HU-specific vendor pages or customer references were found for ATM-as-a-Service from NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf.

result.result_summary: Bilingual search returned only global ATMaaS material plus a regional Diebold representative (BS/2, Lithuania) whose Hungarian coverage is unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: Local ATMaaS supply structure remains unmapped; likely needs procurement award notices and bank annual reports as substitutes.

description: The MNB licensed cash-processors list PDF path (/letoltes/penzfeldolgozo-szervezetek-2025.pdf) was reported by the MNB page but not itself fetched in this pass.

result.result_summary: Link observed on the MNB authorisation page; liveness not tested here, and the year suffix likely changes annually.

why_it_matters: This is the single most valuable actor-census artefact of the cell; the verification pass should resolve the current-year filename.

description: Exact decree number for the MNB regulation setting per-bank minimum ATM counts is not confirmed.

result.result_summary: Media (Bank360, FinTechZone) describe the decree's thresholds; njt.hu results surfaced 5/2025. (IV.17.) and 56/2022. (XII.22.) MNB rendelet without confirming which sets ATM minimums.

why_it_matters: Citing the wrong decree would undermine downstream compliance analysis; needs a targeted njt.hu lookup.

description: No dedicated, published time series of financial transaction levy (pénzügyi tranzakciós illeték) revenue broken down by transaction type (card purchase vs cash withdrawal vs transfer) was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: NAV publishes rules and leaflets, not levy-revenue statistics; searches for 'tranzakciós illeték bevétel statisztika' returned only guidance PDFs, press and secondary figures (e.g. HUF 233bn in 2021 quoted secondarily).

why_it_matters: A per-instrument levy breakdown would be the single strongest tax-derived proxy for Hungarian payment volumes; its absence means the proxy must be reconstructed from aggregate budget lines plus statutory rates, or obtained via FOI.

description: The Ministry of Finance / Government monthly central-budget report ('havi költségvetési jelentés', államháztartás központi alrendszerének helyzete) landing page on kormany.hu was not pinned down to a stable URL in this pass.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced only MNB's budget analysis and press coverage; the kormany.hu monthly release page itself did not appear in results.

why_it_matters: That monthly release is the fastest official carrier of transaction-levy receipts and is the natural high-frequency series for this cell.

description: For both flagship 2025 cash-related acts (cash-acceptance obligation, Act LXII of 2025; and the free-ATM-withdrawal amendment published mid-December 2025) the exact Magyar Közlöny issue number and page were not confirmed.

result.result_summary: Press reports confirm publication in Magyar Közlöny with effective dates (2025-07-01 and 2026-02-01 respectively) but no primary gazette citation was retrieved.

why_it_matters: Downstream collection needs exact citations to anchor the legal thresholds; without them the facts rest on secondary press.

description: The standalone Financial Arbitration Board domain penzugyibekeltetotestulet.hu was referenced in MNB material but not independently reached in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only mnb.hu/bekeltetes and MNB PDF material were retrieved; the standalone domain is a hypothesis (possibly redirecting to mnb.hu).

why_it_matters: Determines whether PBT case data has a separate publication stream to monitor.

description: No Hungarian competition-authority (GVH) source specific to interchange/card-scheme fees was surfaced by this cell's queries.

result.result_summary: Interchange queries returned MNB, EUR-Lex and academic sources only; GVH did not appear.

why_it_matters: GVH case decisions historically shaped Hungarian MIF levels and would add an enforcement-side quantitative source.

description: No dedicated Hungarian-language LinkedIn-based or company-announcement aggregator surfaced that can be collected lawfully at scale. LinkedIn company pages of MNB, GIRO, OTP, Euronet and the HU PSPs are the natural weak-signal channel for hiring and partnership posts, but LinkedIn's ToS and authentication wall make programmatic collection non-viable and no compliant mirror was found.

result.result_summary: Searches returned no HU LinkedIn aggregator or open API mirror; LinkedIn itself is auth-walled and ToS-restricted.

why_it_matters: A significant fraction of HU payments weak signals (role changes, project go-lives, partnership posts) appear first on LinkedIn and will be missed by web-only collection.

description: No speaker list or detailed agenda could be obtained for the Budapest TechShow X (merged PayTechShow/BankTechShow) edition from the aggregator page found; the aggregator described tracks but did not name speakers.

result.result_summary: Track topics described (cards, instant payments/AFR, POS, softPOS, acquiring, ISO 20022, IPR) but no named speakers; organiser's own domain not confirmed in this pass.

why_it_matters: The speaker list is the actual intelligence asset (who is building what); without it the event is only a calendar entry.

description: No Hungarian equivalent of a structured startup-funding database (Crunchbase-style, HU-specific, open) was found for payment/fintech rounds. Funding signals are scattered across trade press (FinTechZone), general media (Infostart, Piac&Profit) and investor sites.

result.result_summary: Only narrative media coverage and investor-side pages; no structured HU funding dataset located.

why_it_matters: Funding-round tracking will require entity extraction from prose rather than a clean feed, raising cost and error rate.

description: Profession.hu and hu.indeed.com were observed only through search-result summaries in this pass; their robots.txt, rate limits and anti-bot posture were not tested. Job boards commonly return 403 to automated clients.

result.result_summary: No fetch attempted/confirmed; access status recorded as unverified rather than blocked.

why_it_matters: Hiring signal is a core part of this cell; if these boards block automation the workstream needs a manual or licensed-feed fallback.

description: Searched in Hungarian and English for a data.gov.hu-style national open-data portal hosting machine-readable payment/card/ATM datasets. The Hungarian landscape is a public-data cadastre and metadata search (kozadatportal.hu, opendata.gov.hu, kozadat.hu) rather than a CKAN dataset store, and no payment/card dataset was actually observed in them during this pass.

result.result_summary: Portals identified as pointers, but no concrete HU payment dataset record confirmed inside them.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising open-data coverage; the operational archive for HU payment series remains MNB's own archive plus web archives.

description: No established Hungarian-language term or portal convention was found for 'discontinued/withdrawn dataset' beyond MNB's own 'archív tartalmak' and KSH's 'archív' labelling; there is no HU equivalent of a formal dataset-deprecation registry.

result.result_summary: Local vocabulary limited to 'archív tartalmak', 'megszűnt tábla', 'korábbi idősor'.

why_it_matters: Query design must lean on those three phrases; broader deprecation vocabulary will not retrieve HU results.

description: The OSZK national web archive, the strongest local complement to the Internet Archive, is largely closed for copyright reasons with only three small public sub-collections.

result.result_summary: Access requires a research arrangement via webarchivum@oszk.hu.

why_it_matters: Automated recovery of withdrawn HU bank/MNB pages from the national archive is not possible; Wayback remains the only self-serve route.

description: Pre-1990 Hungarian statistical yearbooks are digitised but sit behind the Arcanum ADT subscription; no free full-text route was found in this pass.

result.result_summary: Subscription/library access required.

why_it_matters: Long-run cash/monetary baselines are obtainable only with an institutional subscription or via KSH Library.

description: opendata.hu was described in the sources mainly in past tense and its current liveness was not established. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

result.result_summary: Hypothesis: possibly dormant; requires a deterministic liveness pass.

why_it_matters: Avoids recording a false negative for a catalogue that may still mirror withdrawn HU datasets.

description: Despite searching in Hungarian for aggregate online cash-register statistics (NAV online pénztárgép összesített adatok, készpénzes/kártyás tranzakció statisztika), no evidence was found that NAV publishes an open aggregate series of cash-register turnover split by payment mode. All located NAV cash-register data services are scoped to the individual taxpayer's own registers.

result.result_summary: NAV's M2M cash-register download exists but is per-taxpayer; no public payment-mode aggregate located.

why_it_matters: The single richest potential HU cash-vs-card dataset appears to be non-public; obtaining it would require an FOI (közérdekű adatigénylés) or a research agreement, which changes the collection plan fundamentally.

description: No standalone STADAT table dedicated to payment method in retail (kiskereskedelmi forgalom fizetési mód szerint) was found. Payment-method splits appear only inside KSH ICT/e-commerce survey narrative publications, not as a maintained table.

result.result_summary: Payment-mode data exists in KSH ICT publications but not as a structured, machine-readable STADAT series.

why_it_matters: Time-series construction will require PDF extraction rather than table download, and comparability across years must be checked each edition.

description: Searches in Hungarian for a KSH open/JSON API (STADAT API, adatletöltés, nyílt adat) surfaced only the STADAT HTML/XLSX tables and the STATINFO interactive database with a documented ~40,000-cell display limit; no official public REST/JSON statistical API was identified.

result.result_summary: No confirmed KSH public statistical API found.

why_it_matters: Collection design must assume file-level scraping of XLSX/CSV rather than an API contract, raising maintenance cost and breakage risk.

description: No ÁSZ (State Audit Office) analysis dedicated specifically to cash usage (készpénzhasználat) was located; only adjacent analyses on financial awareness/digitalisation and on tech industry/e-commerce.

result.result_summary: Adjacent ÁSZ material only; no cash-usage-specific audit analysis found.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-claiming ÁSZ as a cash-usage source; it remains a low-priority adjacent watch item.

description: Fetched https://www.giro.hu/ and read its navigation (Szolgáltatások, Társaságunk, Dokumentumok, Panaszkezelés, Karrier, Kapcsolat, Rendszer információ). No top-level 'Statisztika' or 'Forgalmi adatok' section exists on the operator's own site.

result.result_summary: GIRO does not maintain a visible, navigable statistics landing page; volume PDFs surface only as hashed /storage/ assets reachable through the document listing or search engines.

why_it_matters: Any collection pipeline that assumes a stable statistics URL for GIRO will fail. Collection must be built on the /dokumentumok listing (and its /api/documents/{id} pattern), or fall back to MNB's statisztika portal for BKR series.

description: Repeated Hungarian searches for 'BKR tranzakciók száma' PDFs returned only 2021 and 2022 vintages (covering data to 2021/2022). No 2023–2026 vintage of the BKR forgalmi statisztika was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only stale public vintages of the GIRO-published monthly BKR transaction-count series were found via search.

why_it_matters: The headline AFR uptake series may have been discontinued at source, moved behind the document listing, or simply not indexed. This is a hypothesis, not a verdict — a direct crawl of giro.hu/dokumentumok is required before concluding the series is dead.

description: The Hungarian phrase 'forgalmi adatok' is heavily polluted: searches surfaced BKK (Budapest public transport) traffic datasets on opendata.gov.hu and bkk.hu rather than payment clearing turnover.

result.result_summary: 'forgalmi adatok' alone is unusable as a query term for this cell; it must be paired with BKR/GIRO/elszámolás/tranzakciószám.

why_it_matters: Query templates for automated discovery must disambiguate, otherwise the pipeline ingests transport traffic data as payments data.

description: No dedicated GIRO Zrt. press room / sajtószoba or news feed was identified in the site navigation or via search; operator-sourced figures reach the public mainly through MNB press releases and trade press interviews.

result.result_summary: GIRO has no discoverable owned media channel for statistics announcements.

why_it_matters: Monitoring must be routed via MNB sajtóközlemények and fintech trade press rather than an operator RSS feed, which adds latency and a second-hand-attribution risk.

description: No public statistical API or machine-readable open-data endpoint was found for GIRO/BKR volumes; KELER offers CSV downloads but no documented API, and the ECB Data Portal is the only API-grade source touching HU clearing statistics found in this pass.

result.result_summary: Collection for this cell will be document-scraping-based, not API-based, except for ECB and MNB downloadable table sets.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for pipeline engineering effort and refresh reliability for the highest-priority metric in HU payments.

description: Searched in Hungarian for a Banking Association-published, recurring quantitative banking-sector statistics series (analogous to the German or Austrian association datasets). No association-hosted statistical dataset page surfaced; sector aggregates in results came from the MNB (central bank) and from individual banks' annual reports, not from Magyar Bankszövetség.

result.result_summary: Association output appears to be qualitative (communiques, position papers, journal articles) rather than a standing statistics series; the quantitative banking-sector series in HU sits with the MNB, which belongs to another coverage cell.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-tasking cell 5 with a statistics-extraction pipeline that has no target; A4 quantitative banking aggregates must be sourced from the supervisor/central bank instead.

description: For the Magyar Fintech Szövetség (hunfintech.com) and EFISZ (efisz.hu) I did not reach a confirmed, enumerable member-directory URL within this pass; membership information came from secondary trade-media coverage (founding members for EFISZ, member categories for HFA).

result.result_summary: Association homepages identified and confidently attributed, but the specific member-list endpoints remain unverified hypotheses rather than found URLs.

why_it_matters: The member lists are the highest-value pointer assets in this cell; a follow-up pass should navigate both sites directly to locate them.

description: Local-language searches for a Hungarian card-issuer or ATM-operator association (terms tried around bankkártya, ATM üzemeltető, kártyakibocsátó szövetség) returned no dedicated body; the functional equivalents are EFISZ on the payment-provider side and the Banking Association's internal working groups.

result.result_summary: No standalone HU cards/ATM association identified.

why_it_matters: Card and ATM statistics for HU will not come from an association layer; expect the central bank and international card schemes to be the only aggregators.

description: English-language searching for 'Hungarian Banking Association sector statistics publication' returned mainly Hungarian-language assets; only EFISZ was observed to maintain an explicit /en/ path. Most association output in this cell exists in Hungarian only.

result.result_summary: English is a shallow entry point for this cell; Hungarian-language collection is mandatory rather than optional.

why_it_matters: Any downstream collector configured English-first would miss the large majority of this cell's content.

description: The Factoring Association appears with two statistics paths in indexes: https://faktoringszovetseg.hu/statistikak-style path and a legacy http://www.faktoringszovetseg.hu/html/statisztika.html. I did not fetch either, so neither is claimed live.

result.result_summary: Two candidate URLs recorded; canonical one to be determined by the deterministic liveness pass.

why_it_matters: Avoids anchoring a recurring collector on a stale legacy path.

description: No dedicated Hungarian-language press room / 'sajtószoba' was located for Barion Payment Zrt. in this pass; searches on 'Barion sajtószoba blog statisztika' returned only product, customer-service and third-party integration pages.

result.result_summary: Barion's public HU surface appears to be product/knowledge-base and price-list oriented rather than statistics-publishing; no recurring transaction-volume disclosure was found.

why_it_matters: The HU-owned #2 online PSP may not self-publish volumes, so its scale will have to be inferred from filed annual accounts and third-party estimates instead of press material.

description: For Cardnet Zrt. no corporate website was confirmed in this pass — only a LinkedIn company page surfaced in HU-language search results.

result.result_summary: Actor confirmed to exist and to operate in POS terminal servicing / cash registers / loyalty cards, but no primary web source established.

why_it_matters: A material terminal-servicing actor would otherwise be missing from the source map; it needs a register-based rather than web-based tracking approach.

description: The Euronet HU press page (euronetatms.hu/sajtokozlemeny/) was fetched and returned content whose most recent datable items were 2016/2022; no 2024-2026 releases were observed on that page in this pass.

result.result_summary: HU ATM counts obtainable there (~420 independent ATMs, ~350 EUR-capable) are dated and must not be used as current figures.

why_it_matters: Relying on this page alone would produce a stale view of the largest independent ATM estate in Hungary; parent-company SEC filings and bank outsourcing notices are needed for currency.

description: Euronet Worldwide's investor materials disclose installed ATM counts by segment/region (EFT Processing) but Hungary-level breakouts were not found in the results reviewed.

result.result_summary: Country-level ATM estate for HU is not a disclosed line item in parent filings.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations: parent filings give direction and regional context only; HU-specific ATM counts require local press, bank notices or MNB data.

description: SimplePay (OTP Mobil) has no public price list; fees are set individually at contracting and only indicative offers circulate (an indicative offer PDF was seen hosted on a third-party merchant domain).

result.result_summary: Acquiring/PSP pricing for the market-leading HU PSP is not publicly published.

why_it_matters: Any HU online-acceptance pricing series will be structurally incomplete at the top of the market and must lean on Barion's public list plus scattered indicative offers.

description: All URLs recorded in this slice except https://www.euronetatms.hu/sajtokozlemeny/ were taken from search-result metadata and were not individually fetched in this pass.

result.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores; liveness is to be established by the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Prevents a false impression of verification; corporate newsrooms (Visa, Mastercard) frequently reorganise URL paths, and the Mastercard HU newsroom already exhibits two distinct historical path patterns.

description: No HU systemic bank was found to publish a standing, machine-readable series of card counts, ATM fleet size or POS terminal counts. Where such figures appear, they are prose or chart values inside PDF annual reports and investor decks, and definitions differ per bank.

result.result_summary: Searches in Hungarian for 'bankkártya darabszám', 'ATM hálózat', 'kártyaforgalom' returned report landing pages and PDFs, never a data table or API.

why_it_matters: Any cross-bank card/ATM/POS series must be hand-normalised from PDFs; the pipeline needs PDF table/OCR extraction plus a per-bank definition map, not a feed reader.

description: No dedicated 'digital bank KPI deck' was found for the unlisted HU banks (K&H, Erste HU, Raiffeisen HU, UniCredit HU, CIB). Only OTP, MBH and Gránit run genuine investor-presentation programmes; the other five publish statutory reports only.

result.result_summary: Searches for 'befektetői prezentáció' plus each bank name surfaced statutory reports and parent-group material, not subsidiary KPI decks.

why_it_matters: Digital-payment KPIs for over half the cell must be sourced indirectly from parent groups or media, lowering comparability and timeliness.

description: No stable Hungarian bank-side term was found for merchant-acquiring volume equivalent to 'POS acquiring volume'. Candidate phrasings ('elfogadói forgalom', 'kártyaelfogadás', 'POS terminál darabszám') were used but did not surface bank-published acquiring statistics in this cell's searches.

result.result_summary: Acquiring-side terminology appears to live with the regulator and with acquirer/PSP entities rather than in bank IR language.

why_it_matters: Acquiring coverage for this cell is likely unreachable from bank IR alone and must be triangulated with regulator and PSP-side cells.

description: Two commercially useful aggregators are restricted: OPTEN company reports are paid, and portfolio.hu's deeper bank analysis sits behind Portfolio Premium. The e-beszamolo bulk dataset is likewise only available via a paid/requested data-supply route, not by scraping.

result.result_summary: Paywall and bulk-data-request models observed on opten.hu, portfolio.hu/premium and e-beszamolo 'beszámoló állomány értékesítése'.

why_it_matters: Budget and licensing decisions are needed if systematic cross-bank financial normalisation is wanted; free routes cover primary documents only.

description: Targeted Hungarian-language search for POS-terminal public procurement notices ('POS terminál közbeszerzés eredmény hirdetmény keretszerződés bankkártya') returned only commercial bank/acquirer marketing pages (OTP, Erste, MBH, SimplePay) and generic Public Procurement Authority pages — no specific POS-terminal tender.

result.result_summary: Generic web search is a poor channel for POS-terminal tenders; the term 'POS terminál' is dominated by acquiring-service marketing noise.

why_it_matters: POS terminal procurement in Hungary is largely private-sector (banks/acquirers) and therefore outside Kbt.; the public-procurement channel will yield POS mainly via state-owned buyers, transport ticketing and municipal cash-desk systems. Retrieval must be done inside EKR/Értesítő/TED with CPV filters, not via open web search.

description: No Hungarian card-personalisation (kártyaszemélyesítés / kártyagyártás) procurement notice or dedicated buyer channel was located in this pass; searches surfaced only TED/CPV background material, not an actual HU notice.

result.result_summary: Card-personalisation tenders not confirmed in this run.

why_it_matters: Card personalisation for Hungary is mostly commissioned by commercial banks and card processors (private, not Kbt.-bound), so public tenders may exist only for state-linked issuers (e.g. Magyar Posta, state health/ID cards, transport cards). The cell's card-personalisation coverage is therefore weak and needs a dedicated CPV-driven pass.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched and verified for liveness; all entries are search-derived with permalink patterns observed in results. EKR and TED portals are JavaScript-heavy and may return 403/challenge to naive fetchers.

result.result_summary: Liveness and crawlability are hypotheses, not verdicts.

why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must distinguish bot-defence (403/timeout, likely live) from genuine relocation (404). Do not mark EKR/TED as dead on a single failed fetch.

description: Hungary is not a CPMI member jurisdiction, so BIS Red Book statistics are not expected to carry a Hungarian country table or HU reference area.

why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collection effort against BIS for HU series; BIS should be scoped to peer benchmarking and definitions only.

description: ECB SPACE (payment attitudes / cash usage survey) covers euro area countries only; Hungary, being outside the euro area, is not a survey country.

result.result_summary: SPACE 2019/2022/2024 material consistently framed as 'euro area'; no Hungarian sample identified.

why_it_matters: Hungarian cash-usage behaviour must come from MNB's own household payment surveys or Findex, not SPACE; SPACE is a comparator only.

description: The 2025 EBA/ECB Report on Payment Fraud excludes Hungary because data were not available over the entire reporting period.

result.result_summary: Search result text explicitly states Hungary is excluded from the analysis for lack of full-period data.

why_it_matters: HU card-fraud benchmarking against EU peers is currently not possible from the supranational layer; must be sourced nationally from MNB.

description: No Hungarian-language interface or publication was found for ECB Data Portal, BIS, IMF FAS or World Bank Findex; only Eurostat exposes a partial /hu Statistics Explained layer.

why_it_matters: Hungarian-language discovery in this cell mostly finds secondary re-reporting of EU/IMF data (media, KSH, ASZ analyses) rather than the aggregators themselves; local-language search must be routed to national cells instead.

description: Eurostat does not publish card/ATM/POS payment transaction statistics; those belong to the ECB payment statistics domain. Eurostat's contribution for this cell is digital-economy and e-commerce demand-side indicators only.

why_it_matters: Avoids misassigning payment-statistics collection to Eurostat and clarifies the ECB/Eurostat division of labour.
